title: Cloud Concepts and Connectivity

header.html: 1.3 Summarize cloud concepts and connectivity options: network functions virtualization (NFV); virtual private cloud (VPC); network security groups and lists; cloud gateways (internet gateway, NAT gateway); VPN and Direct Connect; public, private and hybrid deployment; SaaS, IaaS and PaaS; scalability, elasticity and multitenancy
the official CompTIA Network+ N10-009 exam objectives, version 4.0

html:
1Cloud building blocks

Term Meaning
Network functions virtualization (NFV) Running network functions (routing, firewalling, load balancing) as software on standard servers instead of dedicated hardware
Virtual private cloud (VPC) A logically isolated private network inside a public cloud, with your own IP ranges, subnets and routes
Network security group Stateful rules applied to instances or network interfaces
Network security list / network ACL Rules applied to a subnet, often stateless (return traffic needs its own rule)
Internet gateway Lets a VPC reach the internet and be reached (with public IPs)
NAT gateway Lets private instances start outbound connections to the internet without being reachable from it

Exam tip

. Private servers need updates from the internet but must not be reachable = NAT gateway. Public web servers = internet gateway plus public IPs.

2Connecting to the cloud

Option Detail
VPN Encrypted tunnel over the public internet; quick and cheap; variable performance
Direct Connect (private connection, also called a dedicated link) Private, dedicated circuit to the cloud provider; predictable latency and bandwidth; costs more and takes longer to set up

3Deployment and service models

Deployment model Who uses it
Public Shared provider infrastructure open to many customers
Private Dedicated to one organization (on premises or hosted)
Hybrid Public and private connected together
Service model You manage Example
Software as a service (SaaS) Only your data and use Email or CRM in a browser
Platform as a service (PaaS) Your applications and data A managed web or database platform
Infrastructure as a service (IaaS) Operating system, applications, data Virtual machines, storage, networks

4Scalability, elasticity and multitenancy

Term Meaning
Scalability The ability to handle growth by adding resources (up or out)
Elasticity Automatic scaling out and back in as demand changes, so you pay only for what you use
Multitenancy Several customers share the same infrastructure, kept logically isolated
Exam tip

. Scalability = can grow. Elasticity = grows and shrinks automatically with demand.

Exam tip

. A NAT gateway gives outbound-only access; an internet gateway allows both directions. Security groups are stateful, network ACLs are usually stateless.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Private instances in a cloud network must download patches but must not accept inbound internet connections. What should be used?

  • AAn internet gateway with public IP addresses on each instance
  • BA larger subnet range
  • CA load balancer facing the internet
  • DA NAT gateway
Show the answer

Answer: D. A NAT gateway allows outbound-only access.

S2A company needs a private, predictable-latency link to a cloud provider. Which option fits?

  • AA dedicated private connection such as Direct Connect
  • BA VPN over the public internet
  • CA guest wireless network
  • DA content delivery network
Show the answer

Answer: A. Dedicated connections provide predictable performance.

S3Which service model gives the customer virtual machines and storage but leaves the operating system to the customer?

  • APlatform as a service
  • BSoftware as a service
  • CInfrastructure as a service
  • DNetwork functions virtualization
Show the answer

Answer: C. IaaS provides infrastructure; the customer manages the OS and above.

S4Which statement describes elasticity?

  • AResources grow and shrink automatically as demand changes
  • BResources can only be added manually in advance
  • CResources are dedicated to one customer only
  • DResources are always at maximum size
Show the answer

Answer: A. Elastic systems scale out and in automatically.

S5An organization keeps sensitive data on premises and uses a public cloud for bursts. Which deployment model is this?

  • APrivate cloud
  • BHybrid cloud
  • CPublic cloud only
  • DCommunity cloud only
Show the answer

Answer: B. Combining private and public environments is hybrid.

S6Which device type is replaced by software when an organization applies NFV?

  • ADedicated network hardware appliances
  • BFiber cables
  • CPower supplies
  • DWireless antennas
Show the answer

Answer: A. NFV runs network functions as software on standard servers.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does NFV stand for?

Show the answer

Network functions virtualization.

R2What does a NAT gateway allow?

Show the answer

Outbound connections from private instances without inbound reachability.

R3Name the three cloud service models.

Show the answer

SaaS, PaaS and IaaS.

R4What is multitenancy?

Show the answer

Several customers sharing infrastructure, logically isolated.

R5Which is more private, a VPN or a dedicated connection?

Show the answer

A dedicated connection (Direct Connect).

R6What is a VPC?

Show the answer

A logically isolated private network inside a public cloud.
